title: MessVoice: Hostel Feedback Analyzer
context: Hostel messes collect short text feedback through a form. The committee wants the common complaints, keyword alerts and clean data.
input: Feedback strings, word ids, ratings, dates.

milestones.title: Most common complaint word
milestones.requirement: Word frequencies with a count array over word ids.

milestones.title: Palindrome coupon codes
milestones.requirement: Validate palindromic coupon codes recursively, ignoring punctuation and case.

milestones.title: Merge two feedback forms
milestones.requirement: Merge date-sorted entries from the paper form and the online form in one pass.

milestones.title: Keyword alerts
milestones.requirement: Count occurrences of a phrase such as 'cold food' in the day’s feedback (KMP).

milestones.title: Ratings in a band
milestones.requirement: Sorted ratings: count entries with rating in [2, 4) using two lower bounds.

milestones.title: Clean formatting
milestones.requirement: Validate bracketed tags like [veg](spicy) in entries with a stack.
